Claire — following up with the technical details you asked for. Short summary (for the packet):

- Art. 30 export: we will produce a redacted ledger export including: processing purpose, categories of data processed (e.g., customer identifiers, free-text responses, metadata), retention policy per category, subprocessors involved, and legal basis. We will remove sample values and any direct identifiers. Export format: CSV + PDF summary. (Attachment planned: art30-ledger-export-20270402.zip)

- Logging & retention: access logs (admin console, API token usage, model invocation traces) are retained by default for 90 days in hosted plans; Dedicated customers can opt for longer retention (configurable up to 365 days) with export. Full request-level audit trails (who queried what, request/response timestamps) are available via the Console audit API and can be exported on demand.

- KMS & encryption:
  - Hosted (standard): Redwood-managed keys (AES-256 at rest), encryption in transit via TLS 1.3.
  - Dedicated: optional customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or equivalent (bring-your-key) for disk encryption and secrets.
  - Private (VPC/on-prem): full CMK support with HSM integrations; keys never leave customer control.

- SOC 2 access: we can share the SOC 2 Type II summary under NDA; for deeper artifacts we use a secure share and limited viewer access.

If you'd like more granular log examples (format and schema), I can include a 1-page sample in the packet.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
